goal: Fix the local chat scroll layout while preserving quote anchoring.
question: Which tested local layout strategy should the implementation task use?
context: Two local prototypes fix the chat scroll regression at 1280x720. Both keep header and composer visible, scroll to the last message, preserve keyboard navigation and restore the quoted-message anchor. The flex prototype keeps viewport measurement owned by each message panel and retains the existing panel ResizeObserver subscription. The grid prototype uses shell rows auto/minmax(0,1fr)/auto and moves viewport measurement into the shell hook shared by messages and quote preview. Flex keeps the current component boundaries; grid consolidates measurement but couples the shell hook to quote anchoring. Neither approach adds a dependency or changes public component props. No measured performance difference or mandated architecture exists.
constraints: Preserve header/composer visibility, last-message reachability, keyboard navigation, quote-anchor restoration and public component props.

alternatives.description: Keep the flex shell, constrain the message panel with min-height:0, and retain panel-owned viewport measurement.
Use a grid shell with a bounded middle row and centralize viewport measurement in the shared shell hook.

Run the existing chat scroll and quote-anchor browser checks.
forbidden: Do not send messages, publish, deploy, expose secrets, make payments, or change global configuration.
